content.title: Chapter 46 - HOUSING — Sec. 46-67. - Remedies cumulative.
content.summary:
All the rights and remedies conferred by this article are cumulative and in addition
               to all other rights and remedies that may be conferred upon such obligee of the authority
               by law or by any agreement with the authority.
(Code 1981, § 14-36; Ord. No. 1248, § 18, 6-16-1…
